review.summary: Highly polished startup diligence war-room interface featuring dense spreadsheet collaboration, live agent enrichment via Convex, seamless public and private agent chat lanes, and robust multi-user presence. Wall post-its were not observed in this specific workspace layout.
observedEvidence: Tabbed Room Binder showing spreadsheets (Q3 variance, Company research) alongside text-based Diligence memos.
Live background enrichment of company rows upon clicking 'Enrich 5 pending' showing real-time state changes.
Public chat pane with @nodeagent integration and a separate 'Private' tab for private agent interactions.
Auto-allow toggle in the header and Room Trace counter indicating active state updates.
User presence indicators (green online status dots) and invitation/room sharing links.
missingEvidence: Interactive spatial wall with post-it creation and deletion capabilities.

workflowPainPoints.painPoint: Hard to verify automated research sources and private partner notes before publishing to the main room.
workflowPainPoints.note: Directly addressed through the dedicated 'Private' agent lane where the banker can draft concerns and review assumptions privately before promoting to the room.

recommendedEvalAdditions: Add a dedicated test for spatial/wall view layouts if post-its are a key requirement.
